criteria.description: Case 3 (MAX) §6 capability summary has ≥7 capability rows (D-01 and D-04 both contribute)
criteria.test_command:
cd /home/epmq-cyber/Área\ de\ Trabalho/projects/aegis-phase1 && PYTHONPATH=src ../shared-venv-root/bin/python -c "
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
import re
from aegis_phase1.v2.output.doc_04d import render_doc_04d
from aegis_phase1.v2.llm import MockInvoker

# CORR-075 implementation note: state uses MAX tier (case 3) for consistency
# with criterion description; tier resolution does not affect capability
# catalog rendering (D-01 + D-04 YAMLs are tier-independent).
state = {
    'company_context': {
        'company_name': 'OmniBank Financial Systems S.A.',
        'employees': 5000,
        'sector': 'Banking & Financial Services',
        'scale': 'MAX',
        'jurisdiction': 'Germany (EU)',
        'applicable_regs': ['GDPR', 'CRA', 'NIS2', 'DORA', 'AI_Act'],
        'revenue_eur': 1_500_000_000,
    },
}
inv = MockInvoker()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    paths = render_doc_04d(state, tmp, inv)
    text = Path(paths['AEGIS-P1-04d']).read_text()
# Extract §6 section
m = re.search(r'## 6\. Capability Summary(.*?)(?=## 7\.|$)', text, re.DOTALL)
assert m, '§6 not found in output'
section = m.group(1)
cap_ids = re.findall(r'CAP-D\d+-\d+', section)
assert len(cap_ids) >= 7, f'expected ≥7 capability rows, got {len(cap_ids)}: {cap_ids}'
print(f'OK: §6 has {len(cap_ids)} capability rows')
"

evidence.command_or_output: re.findall(r'CAP-D\d+-\d+', section) yields 9 IDs; exit 0, 'OK: §6 has 9 capability rows'
